method: Read-only public GitHub source inspection at pinned commits; no treatment scanner output, model comparison, or third-party code execution was used to select or label cases.
population_interpretation: The registered v2 exclusions do not remove tutorial or demo repositories. Do not add an outcome-dependent exclusion after seeing a candidate. Record the repository character as an external-validity limitation and keep the source-based label and automatic-lead eligibility separate.

source_cases.assessment: Provisional source-positive: the spec directly types a todo through .new-todo while addTodo() owns the same selector and type-plus-Enter workflow. The README says this is a QA training project. The registered protocol does not exclude tutorials, so repository character limits generalization but is not a reason to discard this case. A second blinded label remains unavailable.
source_cases.automatic_surface: Literal cy.get action under a named cypress/e2e spec with a sibling cypress/support POM; syntactically eligible for lead collection, not a measured lead or reviewer finding.

source_cases.assessment: Source-supported #13 bypass: generic getElement(selector).click() calls duplicate openMenu()/openSettings(). The source has been read independently by two AI reviewers; its demo/template character limits generalization but does not itself exclude it under the registered protocol.
source_cases.automatic_surface: The pageObjects root is supported, but this spec passes computed POM selector members through getElement(); the current literal raw-action collector does not generate this lead. Keep it out of any claim about automatic lead recall, without calling it semantically clean.
source_cases.use: semantic development case; not admitted to automatic-lead effect analysis

Potential clean control: workflow actions use the Page Object methods while direct cy.get calls inspect steps or absent controls. No independent clean label yet.

Supported layout, but not a confirmed #13 positive: the spec performs a negative-login test using shared locators, while cy.login() includes a successful-login assertion and is not an equivalent helper. Other workflows in the named spec use custom commands. Independent labeling is pending.

Potential clean control for this named spec: form actions delegate to FormPage. Other repository specs were not adjudicated. Independent labeling is pending.

additional_source_screen.method: Second read-only discovery round: GitHub repository and code search, tree filtering, then pinned spec/source reads. These are exploratory source screens, not independent labels. Partial means relevant ownership source was not completely adjudicated.

Provisional semantic #13 bypass: the spec types the checkout first/last/zip fields directly while fillInformation() owns that workflow. Spec uses #first-name/#last-name/#postal-code, POM uses data-test selectors, so the exact-selector collector cannot lead this case. The smoke spec may intentionally demonstrate raw selectors; retain this external-validity caveat.

Partial screen: raw cy.get(POM_MEMBER) calls are assertions, not action leads. Ownership source not fully adjudicated.

This narrows source inspection but is not the treatment collector, a model prediction, or a full-repository negative label. Some repositories had only the named spec subset read.

adjudicated_exceptions.verdict: Source-matched guard: cy.get('.shopping_cart_link').click() is deliberately placed after a forceNetworkError intercept to test connectivity failure; the v2 negative-label rule excludes intentional diagnostic canaries.

Source-matched guard: the LoginPage email helper does not establish ownership of differently purposed registration/dashboard-named tests on a generic Cypress demo page. Same selector alone is not #13; the other #password match is commented out.
Source-supported bypasses but inadmissible: absolute imports point to the author's filesystem rather than repository-resolvable source. Related repeated lines are not independent defects.

additional_layout_screen.method: Repository-tree screening only; these names are not source-complete case labels or a prevalence sample.

access_limit: GitHub code-search API reached a shared user rate limit in the first round. It was available again in the later round; no rate-limit bypass was attempted.
next_gate: Obtain 20 fresh independently adjudicated, automatic-lead-eligible positive workflows from at least ten repositories, with paired repairs and independent clean controls, before the disjoint pilot or measured A/B.
